name: Aragorn II
summary: A rugged ranger of the North with a mysterious royal heritage and exceptional tracking skills.

name: Arwen
summary: An aristocratic and ethereal Elven noblewoman of Rivendell of legendary grace.

name: Bilbo Baggins
summary: A well-to-do hobbit of the Shire known for his unexpected past adventures and penchant for writing.

name: Frodo Baggins
summary: A young, studious hobbit of the Shire and nephew to Bilbo Baggins.

name: Beregond
summary: A dedicated guard and soldier serving in the Citadel of Minas Tirith.

name: Bergil
summary: A young boy of Minas Tirith and the son of Beregond.

name: Fredegar Bolger
summary: A plump hobbit of the Shire and a close friend of Frodo Baggins.

name: Tom Bombadil
summary: A merry, enigmatic entity of immense ancient power residing within the Old Forest.

name: Boromir
summary: A proud, martial nobleman and captain from the realm of Gondor.

name: Meriadoc Brandybuck
summary: A clever and resourceful young hobbit of the Shire belonging to the Brandybuck family.

name: Barliman Butterbur
summary: A bustling, forgetful innkeeper of the Prancing Pony in the village of Bree.

name: Celeborn
summary: An ancient Elven lord who rules the golden realm of Lothlórien alongside Galadriel.

name: Denethor II
summary: The stern, brooding ruling Steward of the realm of Gondor.

name: Elladan and Elrohir
summary: Prowling Elven warrior brothers from Rivendell who frequently ride against wild adversaries.

name: Éomer
summary: A fierce and loyal equestrian commander of Rohan's martial forces.

name: Éowyn
summary: A noblewoman of Rohan with a yearning for martial glory and freedom.

name: Faramir
summary: A scholarly and gentle captain of the Gondorian rangers, and younger brother to Boromir.

name: Samwise Gamgee
summary: A steadfast and loyal hobbit gardener of the Shire serving Frodo Baggins.

name: Gamling
summary: An elderly, experienced warrior and counsellor loyal to the king of Rohan.

name: Ghân-buri-Ghân
summary: A chieftain of the wild, forest-dwelling Drúedain people.

name: Gildor Inglorion
summary: A noble and wise wanderer among the wandering Elven companies of the Shire.

name: Gimli
summary: A stout, proud Dwarf warrior skilled with the axe and fiercely loyal to his companions.

name: Goldberry
summary: An ethereal, graceful maiden associated with the springs of the Old Forest.

name: Gollum
summary: A wretched, corrupted creature obsessed with finding a lost magical golden ring.

name: Gorbag
summary: A cynical Orc captain stationed in the garrison of Minas Morgul.

name: Grimbold
summary: A valiant marshal and leader of men from the Westfold region of Rohan.

name: Gwaihir
summary: A noble and majestic giant eagle of the Misty Mountains.

name: Imrahil
summary: A charismatic and chivalrous prince of the coastal fiefdom of Dol Amroth in Gondor.

name: Khamûl
summary: One of the dreaded Ringwraiths serving the Dark Lord.

name: Legolas
summary: An agile Elven prince from Mirkwood possessing peerless marksmanship with a bow.

name: Lugdush
summary: An Orc soldier from Isengard sent on a raiding mission.

name: Mauhúr
summary: An aggressive Orc captain leading a detachment of fighters from Isengard.

name: Rowlie Appledore
summary: A minor resident and gatekeeper figure within the Shire.

name: Sauron
summary: The supreme dark sorcerer and master of Mordor seeking world domination.

name: Shagrat
summary: A brutish Uruk captain commanding the tower garrison of Cirith Ungol.

name: Shelob
summary: An ancient, monstrous giant spider dwelling in the dark tunnels above Mordor.

name: Théoden
summary: The aging King of Rohan weighed down by trials and dark counsel.

name: Adelard Took
summary: A notoriously nosy relative belonging to the eccentric Took family of the Shire.

name: Peregrin Took
summary: A young, impulsive hobbit of the Shire prone to accidental mischief.

name: Treebeard
summary: An ancient, tree-like shepherd and guardian of the forest of Fangorn.

name: Witch-king of Angmar
summary: The terrifying chief lieutenant and sorcerer-king under the Dark Lord's command.

name: Witch-king's winged steed
summary: A monstrous, foul-winged creature serving as the mount of the Witch-king.

name: Gríma
summary: A pale, treacherous counselor and political advisor in the court of Rohan.

name: Bag End
summary: Bag End is a comfortable and luxurious hobbit-hole situated at the top of The Hill in Hobbiton, serving as the residence of Bilbo Baggins and later Frodo Baggins.

name: Hobbiton
summary: Hobbiton is a village in the Shire and the birthplace and early home of Bilbo and Frodo Baggins.

name: Shire
summary: The Shire is the peaceful, rural homeland of the hobbits, located in the northwestern region of Middle-earth.

name: Sackville-Bagginses
summary: A wealthy and ambitious branch of the Hobbit Baggins family residing in the Shire, known for their persistent rivalry with Bilbo Baggins over the ownership of Bag End.

name: the Old Took
summary: The legendary patriarch of the Took family and former Thain of the Shire, famous for his exceptionally long life and his longstanding friendship with the wizard Gandalf.

name: Bywater
summary: A peaceful village in the Westfarthing of the Shire, situated alongside a wide pool and home to well-known establishments such as the Green Dragon and the Ivy Bush.

name: Dwarf
summary: An ancient, sturdy race of miners and craftsmen renowned for their skill in working stone and metal.

name: Hamfast Gamgee
summary: Ham Gamgee, commonly known as the Gaffer, is an elderly hobbit of the Shire and the father of Samwise Gamgee.

name: Holman Greenhand
summary: A Hobbit of the Shire and the former master gardener at Bag End who taught the gardening trade to Hamfast Gamgee.

name: Brandybuck Family
pinyin_or_chinese: 白兰地鹿氏族 (Bólándì Lù Shìzú)
aliases: 白兰地鹿氏族 (Bólándì Lù Shìzú)
summary: A prominent and wealthy family of Hobbits who rule Buckland from Brandy Hall, known among Shire-folk for their unusually adventurous spirit and fondness for boating.

name: Old Forest
summary: An ancient, enigmatic woodland situated just east of Buckland, notorious among hobbits for its dense, shifting paths and seemingly conscious, treacherous trees.

name: Drogo Baggins
summary: Drogo Baggins is a Hobbit of the Shire and the father of Frodo Baggins.

name: Primula Brandybuck
summary: Primula Brandybuck is a hobbit of the Shire who is the mother of Frodo Baggins.

name: Gorbadoc Brandybuck
summary: Master Gorbadoc is a revered past head of the Brandybuck family, remembered as the grandfather of Meriadoc Brandybuck.

name: Brandywine River
summary: The Brandywine River is a major river that forms the eastern border of the Shire, separating it from the mysterious lands beyond.

name: Westfarthing
summary: Westfarthing is one of the four administrative regions, or farthings, that make up the rural homeland of the Hobbits known as the Shire.
